column1: # mapping_set_description: "Curated boundary mapping between the GC DFO Salmon Ontology (subject side, release 0.0.8 plus the 2026-08-13 S9 step-3 cleanup, repo dfo-pacific-science/dfo-salmon-ontology) and the shared Salmon Domain Ontology (object side, repo salmon-data-mobilization/salmon-domain-ontology at commit a5d4f284e859b4c878cbec5baa04d368ab1990d3). Every row is a reviewed editorial commitment grounded in smn's per-term migration provenance: terms smn migrated verbatim map skos:exactMatch; terms smn adapted (definition or scope changed) map skos:closeMatch; one cross-category concept-to-property link is skos:relatedMatch. Same-IRI MIREOT mirrors are identity, not mappings, and take no rows."
